Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:
My prey controls Smudge with on of my corruption counters. Rabbat
hunts, Smudge blocks via medialoc, Nakkie M1Ks. Is smudge still
eligible to block, or does the block fail?

Messages.Author: witness1
Messages.Body:


Nakhthorheb cannot play Mask of 1,000 faces because an effect (Smudge
attempting to block) has been used that could not have been used if
Nakhthorheb were the acting minion.

# Mask cannot be used to mask an action if the Masking vampire is not
capable of taking that action, nor if any action modifiers, reactions,
or other effects (including inherent stealth) have been played on this
action that could not have been played/used if the Masking vampire
were the acting minion. (Not counting blood that has already been
spent.) [RTR 19980623] [RTR 20030519] [RTR 20041202]

-witness1

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


If Nakhthoreb played Mask before the block against Rabbat succeeded, then the
block is not yet successful. Smudge can no longer continue the attempt.

If Mask is played after the block is successful, then the block is successful.

Messages.Author: Chris Berger
Messages.Body:


Which is also not allowed. It sucks, but Nakhthorheb basically can't
be used with Mask. He can play Mask, but only in situations where it
won't be particularly useful. When Nakhthorheb acts, another vamp
cannot play Mask at all. Ever. Even if there are no vampires in play
with corruption counters. It doesn't make sense, but that's what was
ruled.
